reviews.title: Mixing doesn’t work
reviews.text: This app used to play its timers when you’re listening to music. They pushed a new update that totally broke this feature and made it totally unusable. Now if you’re listening to music, then a timer runs, it switches the music off. Horrible. They must not have any QA team.

reviews.title: ⭐️ 1 Star — Please increase the maximum number of sets
reviews.text:
I really like this app, i’ve been a subscriber for two years now and would otherwise rate it five stars, but an important feature is missing for me to use this app to its fullest potential. 
I use it for run/walk intervals and I’d love to use it for my ultramarathon, but the current 99-set maximum is a significant limitation.

For a long race, I need the timer to continue running for several hours without reaching the maximum number of sets and stopping. 
Increasing the limit to 500 sets (or even 999) would make this app much more useful for ultramarathons and other endurance activities. I’m sure there are many other users that would benefit from this feature as well.

I’ve seen other interval timer apps that already support up to 999 sets, but I really like this app’s interface better, and would like to remain with this app. 

If the set limit can be increased in a future update, I’ll happily change my rating to 5 stars.

Thank you for considering!
